component.name: Herakleo
component.summary: Fast IPTV player for M3U lists and Xtream Codes

description.p: Load an M3U list or an Xtream Codes account, find a channel among tens of thousands, and watch it in mpv, VLC, Celluloid or Haruna.

ul.li: Search, filter and scroll 65,000 channels smoothly
Favourites, history and hidden channels or groups
Every view works with the keyboard or a TV remote
No accounts and no telemetry: everything stays on your machine
